records.name: Derived
records.note: Findings, corrections; derived or participant-authored, not a collection source.

records.statement: On 15 of 19 weekdays with location coverage, the first Work visit began between 08:30 and 09:00 (median 08:48).
records.uncertainty: Visit start is the first sample, an upper bound on arrival; sparse sampling widens it.

records.statement: CORRELATION, not causation: days with fewer steps tended to have more evening (20:00 onward) account-activity records (Spearman rho = -0.15, n = 27 days, approx. 95% CI -0.5 to 0.25).
records.uncertainty: Small sample of daily values from one synthetic subject; one of several exploratory comparisons and not corrected for multiplicity; the dependence was built into the synthetic generator.

records.statement: Late-evening account activity might be followed by shorter sleep.
needs_evidence: sleep records; no producer observed in this persona, so the test cannot run yet

records.statement: No conclusion: weekday steps on days after a gym visit differ from other weekdays by -270 steps (n = 8 vs 12; permutation p = 0.53); evidence is insufficient (rule: at least 15 days per group).
records.uncertainty: Groups are below the minimum size; absence of a detected difference is not evidence of no effect.

records.participant_text: Synthetic note: some Monday starts are late because I work offsite.
